# Documentation templates

Frozen templates for the docs ownership model. Acceptance rules: [CONTRIBUTING.md](/CONTRIBUTING.md#documentation-ownership-model).

| Template | Use |
| --- | --- |
| [interface.md](/docs/templates/interface.md) | Boundary both sides must honor (`docs/interfaces/`) |
| [decision.md](/docs/templates/decision.md) | Short ADR (global `docs/decisions/` or `apps/<app>/docs/decisions/`) |
| [system.md](/docs/templates/system.md) | Thin product-area map entry (`docs/systems/`) |
| [app-doc.md](/docs/templates/app-doc.md) | App-local design / as-built (`apps/<app>/docs/`) |
